mobile.signin.diagnostics.note: Reveal a redacted in-memory log containing stage names and error classes only.

mobile.signin.failed.note: Unexpected sign-in or credential persistence failure; never show runtime messages or credentials.

mobile.signin.hide_diagnostics.note: Sign-in support disclosure. Human-readable stage or show/hide control; no credential, URL, token, code or state value.

mobile.signin.progress.note: Visible after the native browser returns, during token exchange and credential persistence.

mobile.signin.retry.note: Retry a failed or cancelled sign-in.

mobile.signin.show_diagnostics.note: Sign-in support disclosure. Human-readable stage or show/hide control; no credential, URL, token, code or state value.

mobile.signin.superseded.note: The current user-initiated sign-in lost authorization ownership without a newer sign-in owning the UI.

mobile.signin.title.note: Screen title of the Radient re-authentication route. Verb phrase, no punctuation.

mobile.signin.intro.note: Reassurance line at the top of the sign-in screen: the sign-in happens in the system browser, so the app never receives the password. Keep that guarantee exactly; full stop at the end.

mobile.signin.start.note: Primary button on the first-run welcome screen and the sign-in screen that starts the browser hand-off. 'Radient' is the brand: keep it in Latin script. Used at two call sites.

mobile.signin.use_address.note: Button that opens the manual connect screen where the reader types a relay address and password. Used on the sign-in screen and in the 'sign-in unavailable' panel; same wording at both.

mobile.signin.panel.opening.note: Shimmering status line while the system browser is being opened for Radient sign-in. Ends with an ellipsis, no full stop.

mobile.signin.panel.waiting.note: Headline of the sign-in hand-off region once the browser is open; announced by screen readers (polite live region). Full sentence with a full stop. A second line, 'panel.waiting_help', renders below it.

mobile.signin.panel.waiting_help.note: Instruction under 'Waiting for your browser.': 'there' means the browser that just opened. Full stop at the end.

mobile.signin.panel.cancelled.note: Headline of the hand-off region after the reader dismissed the browser sheet. Full sentence with a full stop. Different from the diagnostic stage word 'Sign-in cancelled' (mobile.signin.stage_cancelled).

mobile.signin.panel.cancelled_help.note: Reassurance under 'Sign-in was cancelled.': the cancellation altered nothing. Full stop at the end.

mobile.signin.panel.unavailable.note: Headline when this app build cannot receive the browser callback at all. A technical detail line (not translated, from the runtime) renders below it. Full stop at the end; 'Radient' stays in Latin script.

mobile.signin.panel.unavailable_alt.note: Last line of the 'sign-in unavailable' state pointing at the route that works: the relay's address and password (the 'Use an address and password' button below). Full stop at the end.

mobile.signin.try_anyway.note: Quiet button in the 'sign-in unavailable' state that retries the browser hand-off even though this build probably cannot complete it. Short imperative.

mobile.signin.welcome.headline.note: Headline of the first-run welcome screen (screen-reader header). One sentence with a full stop; 'agent' is the product's own word for the assistant.

mobile.signin.welcome.body.note: Supporting paragraph on the welcome screen under the headline: the app controls sessions on the reader's own machine and shows the results; code never leaves the machine ('it' = the machine). Keep the privacy promise exact.

mobile.signin.panel.unavailable_detail.note: Detail under "This build cannot finish a Radient sign-in." on the sign-in screen. Radient is a brand name: keep it. {module} is a software module id for developers: keep it unchanged, left-to-right, inside the parentheses. A "loopback listener" receives the browser's sign-in reply on this device.
